result.title: Active Learning of Robust Models
result.summary: In many domains from species identification to cancer diagnosis, labelling data to train predictive models remains costly. In these settings, it is advantageous to intelligently select data points to label to achieve the maximum information gain, this is the motivation behind the study of active learning. In addition to the high costs of acquiring data in such domains, there is the added complexity of data distribution shifts that can occur between training and deployment. For example, the features of cancerous skin cells taken in one country may be different in another region of the world. These two challenges - efficient labelling of data, and learning models robust to distribution shifts have been studied separately but not together, even though these challenges often co-occur in real-life settings. We identify failure modes of standard active learning approaches when the distribution of data at deployment is different from the distribution in which the data is sampled for labelling. We propose a new strategy for efficiently learning classifiers that generalise under specific forms of distribution shift, namely subpopulation shift. Drawing on work in learning from heterogeneous data, we aim to train models that perform well across subpopulations of the data, through active learning. To handle this challenging setting, we exploit the fact that many datasets include metadata about data collection that can serve as a noisy proxy for each sample's underlying subpopulation. We demonstrate how to leverage these noisy labels during active learning selection, and demonstrate empirically that our approach improves classifier accuracy across subpopulations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究主动学习与部署阶段分布偏移（子群体偏移）同时出现时的标准选择策略失效模式，并提出利用数据采集元数据作为样本所属子群体的噪声代理来指导标注选择，以提升各子群体上的分类精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 用噪声代理变量驱动「信息增益式」样本选择、并在偏移下分别评估各子群体表现，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据/监督预算的筛选及偏移条件下的评价设计存在概念联系，可供核查。
